finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Read new name, fall back to old |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is now `undefined`, not `false` | Treat unset as off |

The 8 warnings left are real deprecations in code the build only names. `fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, `crypto.createCipher`, plus 4 more. Those files are not in this tree. Say the word and I will chase them.
